findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_answer, read_page, verify_citations, check_headers, site_policies, email_auth, wiki_summary, license_detect · Private data: base_lookup, site_policies, email_auth, injection_scan, license_detect · Public sink: verify_answer, read_page, email_auth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_answer, read_page, verify_citations, check_headers, site_policies, email_auth, wiki_summary, license_detect · Private data: base_lookup, site_policies, email_auth, injection_scan, license_detect · Public sink: verify_answer, read_page, email_auth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
